description: This plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains several lines representing different methods, most of which pair a solid line with circular markers showing performance across the x-axis with a horizontal dashed line of the same color. The "DPR w/o query" method is represented by a single solid black line with no markers, remaining constant at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ gold" method is shown as a solid olive-green line with circular markers; it begins below the y-axis minimum at x=1, crosses 33.0 at x=4, and rises steadily to end at approximately 34.95 at x=10. The "DPR w/ top-1" method features a solid dark green line with circular markers, starting at approximately 32.9 at x=1, rising sharply to 34.7 at x=2, and continuing to climb to a peak of approximately 36.4 at x=10; its corresponding dashed dark green line remains horizontal at approximately 34.65. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" method is depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, starting at approximately 34.75 at x=1, rising to a peak of 35.05 at x=3, and gradually declining to end at approximately 34.7 at x=10, with a horizontal dashed purple line at approximately 34.9. The "DPR w/ random" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 34.8 at x=1, increasing to 35.15 at x=2, and remaining relatively stable to end at approximately 35.3 at x=10, accompanied by a horizontal dashed blue line at approximately 35.2. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 35.15 at x=1, rising to 35.55 at x=2, and continuing a gradual upward trend to peak at approximately 35.8 at x=7 and x=9 before ending at 35.8 at x=10; its corresponding dashed red line remains horizontal at approximately 35.6.
